definitions.explanation: An enclosed space for parking and storing vehicles, typically attached to or part of a house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ガレージ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put the car in the garage.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二台分|にだいぶん}→二台分：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ガレージ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This house has a two-car garage.

examples.japanese: ガレージ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}した→修理：03214_shuuri⟧。
examples.english: I repaired my bicycle in the garage.

notes:
ガレージ is from English "garage" and refers to an enclosed structure for parking vehicles, typically attached to or part of a house.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ガレージ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in the garage
- ガレージ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to take out of the garage
- ガレージ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open the garage
- ガレージ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧: to close the garage

COMPOUNDS:
- ガレージ⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: garage sale
- ガレージ⟦ハウス→ハウス：noentry⟧: house with integrated garage
- ⟦{立体|りったい}→立体：18797_rittai⟧ガレージ: multi-story parking garage

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR TERMS:
- ⟦{車庫|しゃこ}→車庫：00361_shako⟧: garage/car shed (native Japanese term, often used for train depots too)
- ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧: parking lot/area (outdoor or indoor, public or private)
- ⟦カーポート→カーポート：27526_kaapooto⟧: carport (covered but not enclosed)

USAGE:
ガレージ typically implies an enclosed private space at a residence, while ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧ is broader and includes public parking areas.
